senses.gloss: m. pl. (preced.) preservers of silence (silentiarii, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Præpositus).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 58a:10">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא תליתאה דהוה ש׳ וכ׳</he> Vers. in ʿEn Yaʿăḳob (ed. <he>כי קא שתקא</he>) when the third division marched past, who were the silentiarii (ordering silence), he (the blind R. Shesheth) said, now the king is coming.
